data.overview: The only brand-specific source is Pascal Coste's own salon website, which describes its professional hair care range and states the products are made in France. No independent evaluations, legal matters, or third-party assessments naming Pascal Coste were found among the fetched sources.

claims.claim: Pascal Coste says its professional hair care range suits all hair types and needs thanks to specific compositions and vitamin complexes that penetrate deep into the hair fibre.
claims.quote: répond parfaitement à toutes les natures de cheveux et aux besoins de toutes les femmes et de tous les hommes grâce à ses compositions spécifiques aux multiples bienfaits et ses complexes vitaminés qui pénètrent en profondeur
